submitNotice: The system sends a background task with the "{{preset}}" strategy. When done, the formula is saved automatically; you don't need to save again.

imitate.label: Stay close to the source
imitate.summary: Keeps more signatures and expression habits; good for short-term style practice.

balanced.label: Keep the main reading feel
balanced.summary: Keeps reading rhythm and progression, softens overly strong signatures; suits most projects.

transfer.label: Transfer only the reusable framework
transfer.summary: Prioritizes rhythm, structure and dialogue logic reusable for long works.

directText.label: Paste text directly
directText.summary: Send a passage or sample chapter to the server-side extraction task.

knowledge.label: Text in the knowledge library
knowledge.summary: Pick the active version; the system freezes a full-text snapshot then learns from representative samples.

analysis.label: Book analysis result
analysis.summary: Generate a formula directly from the style and technique analysis.

sample.label: Smart sampling
sample.summary: Samples representative passages from the start, middle, end and closing; good for long text, more stable.

full.label: Full-text extraction
full.summary: Feeds the whole active version into the model; good for short docs; long docs may be slow or exceed the context limit.

ui.title: Start from a reading feel
ui.description: Choose the starting point you have. The system helps you generate a formula you can test right away; details are adjustable anytime.
ui.templateHint: If you don't know where to start, pick a formula close to what you want. After creating, change genre, adjust rhythm and test-write to check the feel.
ui.briefHint: Just describe the feeling you want readers to get; AI builds a first version for you to test-write. Once you know the rules, you can start from blank too.
ui.blankDescription: Good when you already know which kind of formula to keep and just want an empty framework first.
ui.manualPlaceholder: e.g. urban strong conflict, fast pace
ui.aiTitle: Let AI build one for me
ui.aiDescription: Good when you only know the feel you want but don't want to fill in rule fields yourself.
ui.briefPlaceholder: e.g. fast progression, dense conflict, direct dialogue, no dragging emotions; fits urban and hot-blooded leveling.
ui.extractHint: Generate a formula from material. Text and knowledge-library source text go into a server-side extraction task; book analysis results use style and technique analysis directly.
ui.name: Formula name
ui.sourceTextPlaceholder: Paste the reference text you want to extract a reading feel from. Provide at least one complete scene.
ui.searchKnowledge: Search the knowledge library by document title or file name
ui.emptyKnowledge: No usable knowledge-library documents found. Upload text to the library first, then come back to create a formula.
ui.activeVersion: Active version v{{version}} · {{versions}} versions · {{analyses}} book analyses
ui.reading: Reading the selected document's active version...
ui.noActiveVersion: The selected document has no active version and can't be submitted.
ui.emptyContent: The active version is empty and can't be submitted.
ui.selectKnowledge: Pick a document in the knowledge library; the system reads the active version's full text and freezes a snapshot when the task is submitted.
ui.searchAnalysis: Search book analysis titles or source documents
ui.emptyAnalysis: No usable book analysis results found. After analysis is done, you can create a formula right here.
ui.analysisFallback: The book analysis can be used to generate a formula
ui.sampleNotice: The formula asset still keeps the full source preview; the model only reads representative samples to avoid overly long text exceeding capacity.
ui.fullNotice: Full-text extraction sends the whole active version to the model. For long text, use smart sampling.
ui.analysisDescription: This flow reads the style and technique entries in the book analysis directly; after creating it opens the formula editor immediately.
ui.analysisSelected: Pick a book analysis; the system generates a formula from style and technique analysis without creating a background task.
ui.keepDescription: Decide how much of the source's signature to keep; the system auto-generates and saves the formula per this strategy.
ui.afterSubmit: After submitting, the system extracts, applies the keep strategy and auto-saves the formula. You can close the dialog; the result opens automatically when done.
